name: TUBS-H
reason: Not a distinct product. The only document cited for it (Linke et al. 2020, doi 10.1016/j.pss.2019.104747) describes TUBS-M and TUBS-T and names no TUBS-H, and the institution recorded (ESA) is not the producer of the TUBS family (TU Braunschweig). Retired at the owner's decision.

purchase_info.price_note: Produced by ESA; available via ESA research partnership.
